title: 第七章 十里反噬
slug: 坟头开铺我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

沈清萝最讨厌麻烦。

尤其讨厌这种半夜上门的。先熄了她的鬼火，又把引魂铃震裂，闹到最后，还嫌不够，干脆把自己绑她手腕上了。

红黑契线隐入皮肤底下，腕骨处只剩一道浅痕。不疼，但碍眼。

沈清萝看了半晌：“能剁手解决吗？”

阿青吓得纸边一卷：“阿萝！”

糖糕蹲在柜台上：“剁你的不划算，剁他的应该比较值钱。”

谢无咎冷冷看过去。

糖糕立刻扭头：“本仙不屑与煞气这么重的人说话。”

宋砚压低声音：“渊主，此契来得蹊跷，未查明前，不宜妄动。”

谢无咎摊开掌心。渊主令上的裂纹像被刀划过。

“蹊跷？”

“渊胎失控，血煞契反噬，玄司守墓人误收魂火，再成古契。若说这里没人设局，你信？”

沈清萝把引魂铃往掌心一扣：“你怀疑我？”

“你不值得我怀疑。”

这话说得平静，偏偏比骂人还难听。

沈清萝点头：“那我谢谢你看不起。”

劫煞将站在院门边，黑雾沉沉。墙角几只小鬼贴成一排。

沈清萝瞥他一眼：“劳驾，你的人能不能收一收？我这院里住户胆小，吓散了要赔。”

劫煞将沉默片刻，往后退了半步。

沈清萝：“退半步不打折。”

谢无咎没耐心再听她算账。他抬手，黑煞没入渊主令，压向契线。

引魂铃猛地一震。沈清萝胸口一疼，扶住桌角，茶盏被碰得一响。同一瞬间，谢无咎指节也一顿。他垂眼，腕骨上的契痕也亮了。

沈清萝缓了口气，抬头看他：“你再乱动，我先把你记成谋杀未遂。”

谢无咎冷声：“闭嘴！”

“你弄疼的是我！”

“我也疼。”

“那你活该！”

院中一静。

鬼火灭了七八盏，可院里那些魂火，一个都没散。

她把引魂铃挂回腰间：“你要真想杀，刚才早杀了。”停了停，又道，“现在还问，说明你自己也清楚，小煞灵这事，不是我设的局。”

谢无咎：“你救它，是因为你不知道它是谁。”

“我救它，是因为它快散了。”

两人隔着满院熄灭的鬼火对视。

片刻后，谢无咎转身：“宋砚。”

宋砚低头：“属下在。”

“回幽冥渊。”

沈清萝一愣。

谢无咎侧过脸：“契文堂、玄司、白道旧卷，都不必看。此契因渊胎而起，我自会在归墟峰解开。”

沈清萝立刻道：“那我的铃呢？”

“渊胎带走。”

“引魂铃留下。”

“铃中有渊胎。”

“渊胎在我这里暂时安置。你拿走可以，出示移交文书。”

谢无咎眉眼压下去：“沈清萝。”

“嗯？”

“你是不是觉得我不能杀你？”

沈清萝想了想：“目前看，你能。”

“那你还敢拦？”

“我不是拦你。”沈清萝拍了拍引魂铃，“我是守我的东西。”

谢无咎没再说话。袖间黑雾一卷，带人出了院门。

门外黑雾散开，压在槐荫坡上空的煞气一点点退远。

阿青从铃里飘出来，长出一口气：“走了？”

糖糕跳下柜台，抖了抖毛：“本仙早说过，活阎王也不过如此。”

话音刚落，远处夜色里忽然传来一声闷响。像有什么东西被硬生生扯住，又没扯断。

沈清萝腕骨骤然一烫，整个人往前一栽，额头差点撞上门框。引魂铃在腰间炸响。

Page (1/3)

Shen Qingluo hates trouble the most.

I especially hate people who come to my door in the middle of the night.First he extinguished her will-o'-the-wisp, and then cracked the soul-attracting bell. In the end, it wasn't enough, so he tied her wrists.

The red and black lines were hidden under the skin, leaving only a shallow mark on the wrist bone.Not painful, but an eyesore.

Shen Qingluo looked at it for a long time: "Can you chop off your hands to solve it?"

Ah Qing was so frightened that he rolled up his paper: "A Luo!"

Tanggao squatted on the counter: "It's not cost-effective to chop yours. It should be more valuable to chop his."

Xie Wujiu looked over coldly.

Tang Cake immediately turned around and said, "I don't even bother talking to someone with such a strong evil spirit."

Song Yan lowered his voice: "Lord Yuan, this contract came out of nowhere. It is not advisable to act rashly until it is found out."

Xie Wujiu spread his palms.The cracks on the Yuan Lord's Order looked like they had been cut by a knife.

"Weird?"

"The Yuan Fei lost control, the blood evil contract backfired, and the tombkeeper Xuansi collected the soul fire by mistake, and then it became an ancient contract. If I say that no one set up a trap here, do you believe it?"

Shen Qingluo pressed the soul-inducing bell into her palm: "Do you doubt me?"

"You are not worthy of my suspicion."

This was said calmly, but it was worse than a curse.

Shen Qingluo nodded: "Then I thank you for looking down on me."

General Jie Sha was standing by the gate of the courtyard, and the black mist was thick.There are several little ghosts stuck in a row in the corner.

Shen Qingluo glanced at him: "Excuse me, can you collect some of your people? The residents in my courtyard are timid. If they are scared away, I will pay compensation."

General Jie Sha was silent for a moment and took half a step back.

Shen Qingluo: "There is no discount for taking half a step back."

Xie Wujiu didn't have the patience to listen to her settling accounts anymore.He raised his hand and commanded the Black Demon to sink into the abyss, pressing towards the bond line.

The soul-inducing bell vibrated violently.Shen Qingluo felt a pain in her chest. She held the corner of the table and heard the tea cup being knocked.At the same moment, Xie Wujiu also cracked his knuckles.He lowered his eyes, and the marks on his wrists also lit up.

Shen Qingluo took a breath and looked up at him: "If you move again, I will first record you as attempted murder."

Xie Wujiu said coldly: "Shut up!"

"It's me you hurt!"

"I feel pain too."

"Then you deserve it!"

There was silence in the courtyard.

Seven or eight will-o'-the-wisps were extinguished, but none of the soul fires in the courtyard were gone.

She hung the soul-inducing bell back on her waist: "If you really wanted to kill me, you would have killed me just now." After a pause, she added, "You are still asking now, which shows that you also know that the little evil spirit is not a trap set by me."

Xie Wujiu: "You saved it because you didn't know who it was."

"I saved it because it was about to fall apart."

The two looked at each other through the extinguished will-o'-the-wisps in the courtyard.

After a moment, Xie Wujiu turned around: "Song Yan."

Song Yan lowered his head: "My subordinate is here."

"Go back to Netherworld Abyss."

Shen Qingluo was stunned.

Xie Wujiu turned his face sideways: "There is no need to read the old scrolls of Qi Wentang, Xuan Si, and Baidao. This contract was born from Yuan Fei, and I will untie it at Guixu Peak."

Shen Qingluo immediately said: "What about my bell?"

"Take Yuan Tai away."

"Stay the soul-inducing bell."

"There is a deep fetus in the bell."

"Yuan Tai is temporarily housed here. You can take it and show the handover document."

Xie Wujiu lowered his eyebrows and said, "Shen Qingluo."

"Huh?"

"Do you think I can't kill you?"

Shen Qingluo thought for a while: "At present, you can."

"Then you dare to stop me?"

"I'm not stopping you." Shen Qingluo patted the soul-inducing bell, "I'm guarding what's mine."

Xie Wujiu said no more.Black mist rolled up in his sleeves, and he led people out of the courtyard.

The black fog outside the door dispersed, and the evil aura over Huaiyin Slope receded little by little.

Ah Qing floated out of the bell and let out a long breath: "Leaving?"

Tanggao jumped off the counter and shook his hair: "I have said before that the living King of Hell is nothing more than this."

As soon as he finished speaking, a muffled sound suddenly came from the distant night.It felt like something was being pulled hard but not broken.

Shen Qingluo's wrist bones suddenly felt hot, and she fell forward, her forehead almost hitting the door frame.The soul-inducing bell exploded on his waist.
